author: Mark Manson
description: Canceling plans doesn't have to mean hurting someone's feelings or making up an elaborate excuse. Sometimes, you just don't have the energy to socialize, and that's perfectly reasonable. The key is how you communicate it. A little honesty, reassurance, and genuine effort to reschedule can go a long way in showing someone you still value the relationship, even when you're not up for hanging out.
title: How to Cancel Plans Without Hurting Anyone

author: Mark Manson
description: We like to think we can spot a liar by reading their body language, but most of the so-called telltale signs of dishonesty are surprisingly unreliable. The truth is, we're not nearly as good at judging deception as we think we are, no matter how confident we feel about our instincts. Research consistently shows that people detect lies at rates barely above chance, suggesting that our confidence in reading others often exceeds our actual ability to do so.
title: Why You Can't Tell When Someone Is Lying to You

author: Mark Manson
description: The people around you shape who you think you are. Look at who's holding the mirror.
title: Your Friends Are Writing Your Self-Esteem

author: Mark Manson
description: Attraction and attachment happen to you. Acceptance and commitment are choices. Which level is your relationship on right now?
title: The 4 Stages of Love
